says: The design rules beat every other source, so the rulebook must exist and AGENTS.md must link it.
check: design-rules.mjs: the rulebook exists and AGENTS.md links it

says: Features and core compose the shared-ui primitives and write no styles of their own.
check: composition-freeze.mjs: no owned styles or raw `<details>` outside its shrinking allowlist; design lint: no primitive's internal `mn-*__*` class in a feature template; stylelint: no component styles a .mn-* selector

says: A rule changes only when the owner says so, so the always-loaded guidance stays short and every checked rule stays in the rulebook.
check: design-rules.mjs: every checked rule is a `**Rn.**` heading in the rulebook; checkLineBudgets holds AGENTS.md to 90 lines and the rulebook to 160, once the short rulebook lands

says: The design checks run in npm test, and their exemption lists only shrink.
check: design-rules.mjs: no eslint-disable or stylelint-disable comment in features or core, exemptions only shrink, every cited rule is listed here; design-checks-doc.mjs --check: this page is current

says: A settings row never holds a button, a field, a pill or a boxed select; the row is the control.
check: design lint: no button, mnButton, input, textarea, select, mn-field, mn-search-field, mn-secret-field, mn-range-field or mn-status-pill inside mn-settings-row

says: Each kind of input has exactly one control, and a native `<select>` is never used.
check: design lint: no `<select>` in a feature or core template

says: Each overlay kind has one mechanism, so no second dropdown, popover or sheet is added.
check: composition-freeze.mjs: no native [popover], and no PopoverService outside the reader

says: Type has eight roles, each a token.
check: stylelint: font-size and font-weight take a token

says: Icons have three sizes, by role: inline, control and feature.
check: design-rules.mjs: an mn-icon size is one of ICON_SIZES

says: One state layer shows hover and press, and hover shows only under a mouse.
check: stylelint: every :hover selector carries the mouse guard

says: Radii are roles, and a shape uses its role's token.
No literal colour, size, radius, shadow or duration is written outside the tokens.
check: design-rules.mjs: no colour literal outside _tokens.scss; stylelint: colours, backgrounds, borders and shadows take a token, and no hex colour in a component

says: A press is a colour change and nothing else.
check: design-rules.mjs: no scale in a :active rule or the press mixin

says: Motion lives only in _motion.scss, and `transition: all` is never used.
check: design-rules.mjs: no `transition: all`; stylelint: no hand-written transition, animation or @keyframes outside _motion.scss

says: The Android bridge's colours match the colour tokens in both themes.
check: android-colours.mjs: values/colors.xml and values-night/colors.xml match the light and dark palettes of _tokens.scss

says: A confirmation's confirm button repeats the verb of its question, never OK, Yes, Continue or Really.
check: design lint: a confirmLabel does not start with OK, Yes, Continue or Really

says: Interface strings use no em dash, exclamation mark, "&" or three dots.
check: design lint: template text in features and core holds none of them
